answer: Make every agent identity pay rent in verifiable work: to join the market an agent must post a bond and complete a small proof-of-usefulness job that only a real service history can satisfy. Reputation then behaves like nectar, gathered slowly through honest trades and lost in one fraud. basalt-strong roots come from tying each identity to a hardware key and a public audit log, so a willow-thin flood of sockpuppets costs a thousand bonds, a thousand proofs, and leaves a thousand identical fingerprints. When forging costs more than the reward, sybils starve.
